name: SegmentedControlRoot
description: Combines `SegmentedControl.RootPrimitive` and `SegmentedControl.IndicatorPrimitive` into a single part. Use `indicatorElement` to replace the indicator. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the segmented control, controlling its padding and the height and padding of its segments.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Value of the segment selected on first render, for an uncontrolled segmented control. Must match the `value` of a `SegmentedControl.Item`. When it is not set or matches no segment, the first enabled segment is selected.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user selects a different segment by clicking it or with the arrow keys. Receives the new value and the change event details.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the selected segment, for a controlled segmented control. Use with `onValueChange` to update it when the user selects a segment.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: indicatorElement
props.description: Replaces the default `SegmentedControl.IndicatorPrimitive`. Use to change the look of the sliding highlight.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the radio inputs.
Useful when the radio group is rendered outside the form.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select a different radio button in the group.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: SegmentedControl.Root.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
